limitations: Synthetic one-revision memory-store fixture; no temporal query or SDK transport
Instrumented current-build diagnostics, not the unchanged v0.5 comparison
Warm input reuse does not imply reuse of newly allocated operator outputs
memory_scope: Cumulative process peak including fixture setup and prior cases; cache wire-byte charges exclude decoded JSON allocator overhead and are not RSS.
method: One eager pinned source per size; off disables both validation caches, cold clears both before each pipeline, warm primes one pipeline before measured repeats. New output owners remain fully validated in every mode. Phase wall times exclude statistics snapshots. Independent inspect uses an uninstrumented separate context.
